A dialog of document requests (Print Booklet) sends the open document's requests (bookletFile, printToDevice, cancelPrintJob) instead of edits and answers them as result: Save (ok) closes it, Print (print) and cancelJob keep it open with the job sent in its value sent; refused, errorKind is dialogRequest with code (the request's errorKind) and the dialog stays as it was. Such a dialog is not applied over an MCP connection (it writes a file or prints). Table of Contents saves the style, then makes the TOC with the id that style got ($then: the same undo step; if the TOC cannot be made both are taken back and the dialog stays open). Export PDF (pdfExport) writes the PDF as the export request does, on an engine thread of its own (progress events of job export), keeps the dialog open with what it wrote (exported) and remembers the settings (app settings export, exportFolder). PDF Presets (pdfPresets, an app dialog) sends pdfPresets requests (save, delete, import, export; files at filePath relative to the project) from OK (Save to Project), delete, import and export and stays open. Print (printing) sends printingFile from OK (Save PDF Proof) and closes; print and cancelJob send printToDevice and cancelPrintJob, savePreset saves the settings as a new print preset named newName (userSettings printPresets), and they keep it open. Print Presets (printPresets, an app dialog) saves its own list (saved) once on OK (userSettings printPresets); import and export send printPresets importFile and exportFile (whole paths from the system's windows) and keep it open. Package (package) has stages (stage: choose, running, done or failed): OK sends the package request on an engine thread of its own (its progress in the value progress, dialog-state events marked progress to the screen) and answers once it is through with what it made in result (a folder of that name made meanwhile: back to choose with the next free name; a failure: failure with its code); cancel sends packageCancel while it runs.
